intro: The Crone of the Kraul is an Alliance quest offered by Falfindel Waywarder at Thalanaar, on the border of Feralas and the Thousand Needles. After reading the recovered journal of the fallen dwarf Henrig Lonebrow, Falfindel tasks adventurers with infiltrating Razorfen Kraul and slaying the quilboar crone, Charlga Razorflank.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Poor Heralath! And this dwarf... Lonebrow. What a brave soul he was.
We must not let their valiance go for naught. This crone... Charlga Razorflank... Must be stopped.
Surely, infiltrating the Kraul will be perilous. There isn't time to send word to Darnassus. Friend, assemble a party to slay the crone.
Bring me Razorflank's Medallion as proof of demise.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So long as Charlga Razorflank is mustering a force in Razorfen Kraul, these lands are in great danger.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The crone has been laid to rest. This is fantastic news, friend.
In these times of peril, it is refreshing to see one as brave as yourself.
With Razorflank's minions taken care of, our studies in the area can continue. Perhaps now we can gain further knowledge of exactly what happened to corrupt the resting place of Agamaggan.
However, I fear the answer to that question lies in treachery as well...
